testsuite.name: gspa.ontology.AnatomicalAndComplexConstraintsSpec

testcase.name: bundled anatomical constraints load GO-Uberon-PO-CL links and taxon rules
anatomical constraints accurately distinguish clade-specific developmental processes across eukaryotes
AnatomicalPrior penalizes impossible anatomy and boosts active anatomical structures
CoherencePrior boosts missing partner of obligate heteromeric complex and penalizes isolated singleton
ConsistencyEnforcer in relax mode replaces anatomically invalid GO term with closest valid ancestor
